customPorts.description: Steam query (UDP), always the game port + 1
Game (UDP), reserved by the game: always the game port + 2
Playfield servers (TCP), always the game port + 3

editor.label: Description
editor.description: Shown in the server browser. Supports [b]bold[/b] and [url=...]links[/url].

editor.label: List the server in the server browser
editor.description: Off = players join by IP address or through a friend.

editor.label: Kick players with a ping above (ms)
editor.description: 0 = never.

editor.label: VIP players
editor.description: Steam IDs (64-bit) of players who may always log in, even when the server is full, separated by commas.

editor.label: Save game name
editor.description: The folder of the game in Saves/Games. A new name starts a new game.

editor.label: Seed
editor.description: The same seed creates the same galaxy. Used for a new game.

editor.label: Scenario
editor.description: The scenario of a NEW game (Content/Scenarios). Install Workshop scenarios on the Mods page, then pick one here and change the save game name: an existing save keeps the scenario it was created with.

editor.label: Playfield servers kept running
editor.description: Started in advance so players do not wait when they warp. Each one uses about 1 GB of memory.

editor.label: Largest blueprint size class allowed
editor.description: 1 = only small blueprints, 10 = any size.

editor.label: Playfield heartbeat timeout (seconds)
editor.description: A playfield server that sends no heartbeat for this long is stopped.

editor.label: Player heartbeat timeout (seconds)
editor.description: A player who sends no heartbeat for this long is disconnected.

editor.label: Playfield start timeout (seconds)
editor.description: 0 = no timeout.

editor.label: Players who may log in at the same time
Restart the playfield servers every (hours)
editor.description: Players get warning messages first. 0 = never.

editor.label: Scenario uses DLC features
editor.description: Every player who joins must own the DLC.

script.name: Install Wine and its dependencies
script.description: Installs wine, winetricks, Xvfb and xdotool on the host (apt, dnf or yum) and creates the Wine prefix of the server. Skips what is already installed.

script.name: Telnet console
script.description: Sends console commands to the server over its telnet admin console (Tel_Port, password = the service RCON password).

script.name: Save the game and shut down
script.description: Sends saveandexit 0 to the telnet console (saves the game, stops the playfield servers) and waits until the server exits.

script.name: Install the Workshop scenario
script.description: Moves the downloaded Workshop scenario to Content/Scenarios, where the Scenario setting finds it.

script.name: Remove the Workshop scenario
script.description: Deletes the scenario folder of the Workshop item from Content/Scenarios.

script.name: Delete old crash reports
script.description: Under Wine the Unity runtime crashes while it exits (after the game is saved) and writes a crash report on every stop; keeps the newest five.
